about: Golden vectors for evidence segment format v4 (DAN-411, contract docs/contracts/evidence-segment-v4.md, attack plan #1659). All data is invented.

v4 is v3 with the sources import and ai-transfer and the optional pasteOrigin on paste; every other rule of v3 holds. These vectors add to evidence-v2.json and evidence-v3.json and change none of them.
Derived outside the repository code: Python json.dumps with sorted keys and compact separators (JCS for this ASCII data) and hashlib.sha256. Never regenerate them from the code under test.

accepted.name: v4-import
accepted.note: An imported document as one import event, followed by a typed event.

accepted.name: v4-ai-transfer
accepted.note: A typed event, then text transferred from the AI assistant.

accepted.name: v4-paste-origin-ai-response
accepted.note: A paste that claims an AI response as its origin.

accepted.name: v4-paste-origin-source-notebook
accepted.note: A paste that claims a source notebook item as its origin, next to a paste without a claim.

accepted.name: v4-every-feature
accepted.note: Every v4 feature with v2 and v3 sources in one segment.

rejected.name: v3-with-import
rejected.note: A v3 header around an import event: the new source is refused in v3.

rejected.name: v2-with-ai-transfer
rejected.note: A v2 header around an ai-transfer event.

rejected.name: v3-with-paste-origin
rejected.note: A v3 header around a paste with pasteOrigin: the key is refused in v3.

rejected.name: v4-without-v4-feature
rejected.note: A v4 header around v3 content: each content has one schema.

rejected.name: v4-import-without-import-id
rejected.note: importId is required with import.

rejected.name: v4-import-without-manifest-hash
rejected.note: importManifestSha256 is required with import.

rejected.name: v4-import-id-uppercase
rejected.note: A UUID in upper case is not canonical.

rejected.name: v4-import-id-nil
rejected.note: The nil UUID is not a v4 UUID.

rejected.name: v4-import-id-version-1
rejected.note: A version 1 UUID is refused.

rejected.name: v4-import-id-without-hyphens
rejected.note: A UUID must have 36 characters with hyphens.

rejected.name: v4-manifest-hash-uppercase
rejected.note: A binding hash in upper case.

rejected.name: v4-manifest-hash-63
rejected.note: A binding hash of 63 characters.

rejected.name: v4-transfer-without-hash
rejected.note: aiTransferSha256 is required with ai-transfer.

rejected.name: v4-transfer-with-import-id
rejected.note: importId belongs to import only.

rejected.name: v4-import-with-paste-origin
rejected.note: pasteOrigin belongs to paste only.

rejected.name: v4-paste-with-import-id
rejected.note: importId on a paste.

rejected.name: v4-drop-with-paste-origin
rejected.note: drop carries no pasteOrigin until the owner decides O-6.

rejected.name: v4-paste-origin-unknown-kind
rejected.note: pasteOrigin.kind is a closed set.

rejected.name: v4-paste-origin-with-text
rejected.note: pasteOrigin never carries text (D9).

rejected.name: v4-paste-origin-without-text-hash
rejected.note: textSha256 is required in pasteOrigin.

rejected.name: v4-paste-origin-null
rejected.note: pasteOrigin is an object when present, never null.

rejected.name: v4-applied-suggestion
rejected.note: Reserved sources stay refused in v4 (D-34).

rejected.name: v4-event-time
rejected.note: An event has no time of its own (D-24, D-56).
